core_obligations: Show that M tensor K is a finite dimensional vector space, so the rank r is finite (proof lines 5098-5099).

Choose generators x_1 to x_n of M and a basis e_1 to e_r of M tensor K, write each generator in that basis, clear all denominators with one element b and deduce that the comparison map M to the direct sum of Re_j is well defined and becomes an isomorphism after tensoring with K (proof lines 5102-5116); this is assertion (2).

Show that the cokernel of that comparison map is finite and torsion, choose g annihilating it, split M_g as N plus R_g^r with N finite torsion, choose g' annihilating N and set f = gg', concluding that M_f is free of rank r, which is assertion (3) (proof lines 5119-5128).

Choose a basis y_1 to y_r of M_f and write each y_j as m_j/f^{t_j} with m_j in M, so that the map sending the j-th basis vector to m_j is an injection R^r to M with torsion cokernel, which is assertion (4) (proof lines 5131-5135).

difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four equivalent-looking descriptions of a finite module M of rank r over a domain: finiteness of the rank, the existence of a map to R^r with torsion kernel and cokernel, the existence of a single nonzero f making M_f free of rank r, and the existence of an injection R^r to M with torsion cokernel (statement lines 5083-5094). Its proof is the longest of the section (proof lines 5097-5137) and is the one that genuinely has to build objects rather than reduce to a definition. It starts by choosing generators of M and a basis of M tensor K and clearing all denominators with one element b, which makes the comparison map to R^r well defined and an isomorphism after tensoring with K (proof lines 5102-5116); then it shows the cokernel of that map is finite and torsion and chooses g annihilating it, splits M_g as N plus R_g^r, kills the remaining finite torsion module N by a further g', and concludes that M_f is free of rank r for f equal to gg' (proof lines 5119-5128); finally it writes a basis of M_f as m_j/f^{t_j} to produce the injection of (4) (proof lines 5131-5135). The last step is closed by the author with 'Details omitted.', which is reproduced verbatim; the three constructive steps before it are complete.
